title: Invoice recovery outcomes
subtitle: Monthly statements for payments recorded after a logged Vireek follow-up. Every line is traceable and you can contest any of them.

dispute.reasonHint: 10 to 2,000 characters. Contested lines are not billed until we resolve it.

methodology.title: How outcomes are counted
methodology.intro: A line is billable only when all four conditions hold:
methodology.c1: Vireek performed a logged action on the invoice (fix, resubmit, follow-up or escalation).
methodology.c2: The invoice was at risk when the action happened: older than the threshold or carrying an uncleared rejection.
methodology.c3: Payment arrived after the action, inside the attribution window and after the original due date.
methodology.c4: A person confirmed it, or the evidence chain is complete.
methodology.never: Never counted: invoices paid within normal terms, disputed, credited, voided or written off, and anything already counted before.

baseline.title: Compared with your baseline
baseline.missing: Baseline missing: no before/after comparison is shown.
baseline.insufficient: Insufficient data: samples are too small to compare honestly.
baseline.observational: Observational comparison only. It does not show that Vireek caused the change.

zero.suspended: Outcome fee paused because measurement quality is under review.
zero.model_none: No outcome fee in your plan.
zero.baseline_missing: No baseline yet, so no fee.
zero.invalid_terms: Terms need review; nothing was charged.

disclaimer: This statement shows payments recorded after a logged follow-up, using the written rules above. It does not prove that Vireek caused a payment and does not guarantee future results. You may contest any line.

empty.title: No statements yet
empty.desc: Statements appear after a month with qualifying activity.

denied.title: Not available on your account
denied.desc: Outcome-based billing is not switched on for this account.

offline: You are offline. Changes can't be sent until you reconnect.

success.disputed: Contest sent. This line won't be billed until it's resolved.

errors.already_contested: This line already has an open contest.
errors.contest_window_closed: The contest window for this statement has closed. Please contact support.
errors.statement_not_contestable: This statement can't be contested in its current state. Please contact support.
errors.feature_disabled: Outcome-based billing is not active on your account.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
